title: How Sabotage fantasy football scoring works
description: A fantasy football league where the worst plays score. Incompletions, sacks, carries, catches, fumbles, interceptions, missed kicks and defenses that give up points all count. Every NFL player since 1999, ranked by Sabotage points at starsofsabotage.com.
alt_text: Stars of Sabotage scoring card listing the points each bad play earns: incompletions, sacks, carries, receptions, fumbles, lost fumbles, interceptions, pick sixes, missed field goals and extra points, and defensive points allowed.
